paragraphs: Siptu is the biggest trade union in Ireland. On Thursday, its leaders said yes to a new pay deal. They want their members to vote for it too.
The deal is for people who work for the State. There are more than 400,000 of them. They include nurses, teachers and office workers.
Most of these workers will get 10.75 per cent more pay. The deal lasts for 33 months. It started on 1 July 2026.
Siptu has about 75,000 members in the public sector. Fórsa, another big union, also supports the deal. Unions for nurses and teachers say yes too.
Not everyone is happy. Some members do not like the deal. Each union will count its votes before Christmas.
sentZh: SIPTU是愛爾蘭最大的工會。
週四，它的領導層對一項新的薪資協議表示同意。
他們也希望會員投票支持它。
這項協議是給為國家工作的人。
這些人超過四十萬名。
其中包括護理師、老師和辦公室職員。
這些員工大多會加薪10.75%。
協議為期33個月。
從2026年7月1日開始。
SIPTU在公部門約有七萬五千名會員。
另一個大工會Fórsa也支持這項協議。
護理師和教師的工會也表示贊成。
並不是每個人都滿意。
有些會員不喜歡這項協議。
每個工會將在聖誕節前完成計票。

paragraphs: Siptu, the largest trade union in Ireland, has told its members to vote in favour of a new pay deal for the public sector. The union's national executive met on Thursday morning and agreed to support the plan.
The deal was agreed last week after long talks between unions and the Government. It covers more than 400,000 people who work in the public sector and the civil service.
Most of these workers will get pay rises of 10.75 per cent in total. The rises will be spread over 33 months, starting from 1 July 2026.

Siptu represents about 75,000 public sector workers. Fórsa, which has nearly 100,000 members in the sector, had already said its members should accept the deal. The unions for nurses and midwives, primary teachers and the Teachers' Union of Ireland have done the same. Their votes will finish in early December.

Adrian Kane, a senior Siptu official who helped lead the talks, said members had stayed strong when the Government refused to move. He said the deal gives fair pay rises, and the union will keep checking that public services are good.

The ASTI, a union for secondary teachers, has worries about one payment in the deal. It will decide what to do at the weekend. Some union members, including a group called Fórsa Left, are against the deal.
All the results should be known before the end of the third week of December. In each union, a majority of members will decide.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭最大工會SIPTU已告訴會員投票支持一項新的公部門薪資協議。
該工會的全國執行委員會於週四早上開會，同意支持這項方案。
這項協議是在工會與政府長時間談判後，於上週達成的。
它涵蓋超過四十萬名在公部門和公務體系工作的人。
這些員工大多總共會加薪10.75%。
加薪將分攤在33個月內，從2026年7月1日起算。
SIPTU代表約七萬五千名公部門員工。
在該部門擁有近十萬名會員的Fórsa，早已表示會員應接受協議。
護理師與助產師工會、小學教師工會以及愛爾蘭教師聯盟也這麼做了。
他們的投票將在十二月初結束。
協助主導談判的SIPTU資深幹部Adrian Kane說，在政府拒絕讓步時，會員們堅持住了。
他說這項協議帶來公平的加薪，工會也會持續監督公共服務的品質。
中學教師工會ASTI對協議中的一筆款項有所擔憂。
它將在週末決定怎麼做。
部分工會成員，包括一個名為「Fórsa左派」的團體，反對這項協議。
所有結果應會在十二月第三週結束前揭曉。
在每個工會中，將由多數會員決定。

paragraphs: Siptu, the country's largest trade union, has recommended that its members accept the provisional public sector pay agreement reached last week after lengthy negotiations. The decision was taken at a meeting of the union's national executive on Thursday morning.
Under the deal, most of the more than 400,000 public and civil servants would receive pay increases worth 10.75 per cent. The agreement would run for 33 months, starting from 1 July 2026.

Siptu represents around 75,000 public sector employees. Fórsa, which has close to 100,000 members in the sector, had already backed the proposals, as had the executives of the Irish Nurses and Midwives Organisation, the Irish National Teachers' Organisation and the Teachers' Union of Ireland. Ballots in those unions will close in early December.

Adrian Kane, Siptu's deputy general secretary and one of the lead negotiators, said members had held firm in the face of what he called the Government's stubborn approach. In his view, the proposals deliver fair pay rises and direct employment, and the union will continue to hold the Government to account on the standard of public services.
The Association of Secondary Teachers Ireland, which has raised concerns about a payment linked to a local bargaining agreement, was expected to decide its position over the weekend.

The recommendations had been widely expected, especially from unions whose senior officials sat on the negotiating team. However, the deal does face some opposition, including from the Fórsa Left grouping.

Results are due by the end of the third week of December, with a simple majority in each union deciding the outcome for its members. Unions representing most affected workers now regard the deal as the best available in the circumstances.
sentZh: 全國最大工會SIPTU建議會員接受上週經過漫長談判後達成的暫定公部門薪資協議。
這項決定是在週四早上該工會全國執行委員會的會議上作出的。
根據協議，四十多萬名公職人員與公務員中的大多數將獲得10.75%的加薪。
協議為期33個月，自2026年7月1日起生效。
SIPTU代表約七萬五千名公部門員工。
在該部門擁有近十萬會員的Fórsa早已支持這些提案，愛爾蘭護理師與助產師組織、愛爾蘭全國教師組織及愛爾蘭教師聯盟的執委會也一樣。
這些工會的投票將於十二月初截止。
SIPTU副秘書長、首席談判代表之一的Adrian Kane說，面對他所稱政府的頑固態度，會員們立場堅定。
他認為，這些提案帶來公平的加薪與直接聘用，工會也將持續就公共服務水準要求政府負責。
對一筆與地方協商協議相關的款項表達疑慮的愛爾蘭中學教師協會，預計在週末決定其立場。
這些建議早在普遍預料之中，尤其是高層幹部參與談判團隊的工會。
然而，協議確實面臨一些反對，包括來自「Fórsa左派」團體的反對。
結果預計在十二月第三週結束前公布，各工會將以簡單多數決定其會員的結果。
代表大多數受影響員工的工會，現在都認為這是在當前情況下最好的協議。

paragraphs: Siptu, the State's largest trade union, has urged its members to endorse the provisional public sector pay accord struck last week following protracted negotiations. The recommendation was issued after its national executive convened on Thursday morning.
The agreement would grant most of the country's 400,000-plus public and civil servants cumulative increases of 10.75 per cent over a 33-month term commencing on 1 July 2026.

Siptu speaks for roughly 75,000 public sector staff. Fórsa, whose membership in the sector approaches 100,000, had already thrown its weight behind the package, as had the leadership of the nurses' union and the main teaching unions. Balloting in those organisations concludes in early December.

Adrian Kane, Siptu's deputy general secretary and a principal negotiator, said members had stood their ground against official intransigence. He argued that the terms secure equitable pay rises and direct employment, and pledged that the union would keep the Government's feet to the fire on the quality of public services.
The Association of Secondary Teachers Ireland, which has voiced misgivings over the payment of a local bargaining agreement, was due to determine its stance at the weekend.
The endorsements came as little surprise, particularly from unions whose senior figures had a seat at the negotiating table. Nonetheless, pockets of dissent remain, notably the Fórsa Left faction.

Ballot outcomes are expected by the close of the third week of December, with a majority vote in each union proving decisive. Unions accounting for the bulk of affected workers have now accepted the deal as the best attainable in the prevailing circumstances.
sentZh: 國內最大工會SIPTU敦促會員認可上週經過冗長談判後達成的暫定公部門薪資協議。
該建議是在其全國執行委員會週四早上召開會議後發布的。
這項協議將讓全國四十多萬名公職人員中的大多數，在自2026年7月1日起的33個月期間內累計加薪10.75%。
SIPTU代表大約七萬五千名公部門員工發聲。
在該部門會員人數接近十萬的Fórsa早已全力支持這套方案，護理師工會和主要教師工會的領導層也是如此。
這些組織的投票將於十二月初結束。
SIPTU副秘書長兼主要談判代表Adrian Kane表示，會員們面對官方的強硬態度堅守立場。
他主張這些條件確保了公平的加薪與直接聘用，並承諾工會會在公共服務品質上持續向政府施壓。
對地方協商協議款項的支付表達疑慮的愛爾蘭中學教師協會，預定在週末決定其立場。
這些支持並不令人意外，尤其是高層人物曾坐上談判桌的工會。
儘管如此，仍有零星的反對聲音，特別是「Fórsa左派」派系。
投票結果預計於十二月第三週結束前出爐，各工會的多數票將具決定性。
代表大部分受影響員工的工會，如今已接受這項協議為當前情勢下所能爭取到的最佳結果。

paragraphs: Siptu, Ireland's largest trade union, has formally recommended that its members ratify the provisional public sector pay agreement concluded last week after prolonged negotiations. The decision was reached at a meeting of the union's national executive on Thursday morning.

The agreement would provide the majority of the more than 400,000 public and civil servants with cumulative pay increases of 10.75 per cent. These increases would be distributed over a 33-month period commencing on 1 July 2026.

Siptu represents approximately 75,000 public sector employees. Fórsa, which has almost 100,000 members in the sector, had previously endorsed the proposals, as had the executives of the principal nursing and teaching unions. Consequently, a substantial proportion of the workforce is now covered by positive recommendations, with several ballots concluding in early December.

Adrian Kane, Siptu's deputy general secretary and a lead negotiator, maintained that members had remained resolute despite what he characterised as the Government's inflexibility. He contended that the terms deliver fair remuneration and direct employment, and emphasised that the union would continue to hold the Government accountable for public service standards.

Nevertheless, endorsement is not universal. The Association of Secondary Teachers Ireland has expressed reservations regarding a payment associated with a local bargaining agreement, while the Fórsa Left grouping opposes the deal outright.

Ultimately, ratification is contingent upon a majority vote within each individual union, and results are anticipated by the end of the third week of December. Unions representing the vast majority of affected workers currently regard the agreement as the most favourable outcome achievable under the prevailing conditions.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭最大工會SIPTU已正式建議會員批准上週經長期談判後達成的暫定公部門薪資協議。
這項決定是在週四早上該工會全國執行委員會的會議上達成的。
這項協議將讓四十多萬名公職人員中的多數獲得累計10.75%的加薪。
這些加薪將分配在自2026年7月1日起的33個月期間內。
SIPTU代表約七萬五千名公部門員工。
在該部門擁有近十萬會員的Fórsa先前已表態支持這些提案，主要護理及教師工會的執委會也是如此。
因此，相當大比例的勞動人口如今都獲得了贊成的建議，數項投票將於十二月初結束。
SIPTU副秘書長兼首席談判代表Adrian Kane堅稱，儘管政府在他看來缺乏彈性，會員們仍保持堅定。
他主張這些條件帶來合理的報酬與直接聘用，並強調工會將持續要求政府為公共服務水準負責。
然而，支持並非全面性的。
愛爾蘭中學教師協會對一筆與地方協商協議相關的款項表示保留，而「Fórsa左派」團體則完全反對這項協議。
最終，協議能否批准取決於各工會內部的多數投票，結果預計在十二月第三週結束前出爐。
代表絕大多數受影響員工的工會，目前認為這項協議是當前條件下能達成的最有利結果。
